The budget is 10 uA reference, 10 uA tail and 40 uA output, about 120 uW at 1.98 V. GBW = gm1/(2*pi*Cc) is about 4 MHz. The pole p2 = gm6/CL sits near 35 MHz. Rz is set to (1+CL/Cc)/gm6 so its zero cancels p2, which should give PM above 75 degrees. Slew is set by Itail/Cc, about 4 V/us. A large-area input pair keeps flicker noise low."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14, 10, 18),        # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),     # input pair L
    "Itail": (10e-6, 6e-6, 24e-6),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),     # PMOS mirror load + output PMOS L (matched -> no systematic offset)
    "gmidp": (12, 8, 15),         # PMOS load / output device gm/Id
    "I6":    (40e-6, 20e-6, 80e-6),
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),     # NMOS current sources L
    "Cc":    (2.5e-12, 1.2e-12, 5e-12),
    "kz":    (1.0, 0.6, 1.6),     # Rz scale relative to pole-zero cancellation value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]
    gmid_n = 11.0
    # bias / current sinks (all same L & gm/Id -> accurate mirroring)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=None or 0.65)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)
    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.25)
    # PMOS mirror load and output PMOS (same density)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=0.8)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)

    gm6 = m6.gm
    Rz = p["kz"] * (1.0 + CL / Cc) / gm6

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinp drives the side whose drain is the 1st-stage output (non-mirror side) -> overall non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (C1 * Cc + C1 * CL + CL * Cc) / (2 * PI)
    zero_resid = 0.0 if abs(p["kz"] - 1) < 1e-9 else 0.0
    p3 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) * (abs(1 - p["kz"]) + 0.3) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) * 0.5
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))
    vdd = 1.8
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I6)
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    gm5_r = m5.gds
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * A1 / max(gm5_r, 1e-12) * (m3.gm / (m3.gm + 1e-12)) / max(A1, 1))  # ~ 2*gm1*gm3/(gds5*...)
    cmrr = db((gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)) * 2 * m3.gm / max(gm5_r, 1e-15) / max(A1, 1)) + 0  # rough
    psrr = gain - 6
    therm = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise = therm * 2.0   # flicker allowance at 1 kHz
    return n, {"gain_db": gain, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "power": power,
               "settle": settle, "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr,
               "noise_1k": noise}
